categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in industrial computer boards and systems, industrial automation control, and other related products. It designs and manufactures embedded motherboards, edge computing computers, industrial-grade systems, medical application devices, and vehicle-mounted computing systems, serving vertical markets such as factory automation, transportation, smart cities IoT, smart healthcare, military defense, gaming, retail, and smart energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages AI edge computing, virtualization technology, and Intel x86 architecture with Slim Bootloader for low power consumption and fast boot times. It develops remote management modules with server-grade BMC functions and integrates AI algorithms into embedded modules. Manufacturing processes include SMT, wave soldering, manual insertion, and rigorous quality control with certifications like ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 50001, and QC 080000.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial automation, smart transportation, smart healthcare, defense, retail, and energy sectors. The company serves OEM/ODM clients globally, focusing on vertical markets requiring durable, stable, and long-life computing platforms. Major end markets are factory automation, intelligent transportation, smart medical, and emerging AI edge computing applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant markets in the Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific (including Japan, Korea, India), and emerging markets in Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Africa. It has a strong presence in Taiwan with manufacturing and R&D facilities and targets strategic expansion in Germany, Spain, and Nordic countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment as a designer and manufacturer of industrial computer boards and systems, integrating components from upstream suppliers such as ICs, PCBs, and passive components. It also provides ODM/OEM services and system integration, positioning itself as a solution provider in the industrial computer supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI edge computing platforms across low to high-performance tiers, deepening vertical market applications (smart manufacturing, healthcare, transportation, energy, defense), and enhancing high-performance, low-power micro products. The company focuses on remote management integration, green product development aligned with ESG goals, and expanding AI ecosystem partnerships to accelerate edge AI deployment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of industrial computer boards, embedded systems, and related hardware. The company also offers customized ODM/OEM solutions and after-sales services. It leverages strategic partnerships and alliances to enhance product offerings and market reach, with a focus on increasing product value and gross margin through innovation and vertical market specialization.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other Taiwanese industrial computer manufacturers and global players focusing on AI and system integration. It differentiates itself through strong design capabilities, global delivery networks, and strategic alliances with major AI hardware suppliers like Intel, AMD, and Qualcomm. The company aims to transition from a hardware supplier to a smart system partner to maintain competitiveness amid increasing market consolidation and technological shifts.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated net revenue of approximately NT$9.58 billion in 2024, representing a 4% growth from the previous year. Operating profit increased by 21%, and net profit rose by 41%, supported by acquisitions and improved product mix. Total assets grew by 36%, and equity increased by 17%, reflecting expansion and stable financial health. The company maintains a steady growth trajectory with ongoing investments in R&D and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes durable, stable, and adaptable industrial computing platforms designed for harsh environments and long operational lifecycles. It offers multi-functional AI edge computing with cost and energy efficiency, integrated remote management, and compliance with stringent industry standards. Its agile design and customization capabilities, combined with strong vertical market expertise and global service networks, provide customers with comprehensive, innovative solutions that enhance operational efficiency and reduce total cost of ownership.
